name: Microgrid resource command-acceptance feedback
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Receives the controller's declared acceptance or rejection of the assigned operating target.
description: Receives the controller's declared acceptance or rejection of the assigned operating target. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Command acknowledgement” at the input and “Accepted or rejected target status” at the output. Acceptance differs from delivered physical response.
